extracted.intended_audience: clinicians, surgeons, and medical students preparing medical or surgical case reports
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing medical case reports (and a surgical subvariant) following the CARE and SCARE checklists to ensure accuracy, transparency, and usefulness. Includes required manuscript sections and, for SCARE, more detailed items relevant to surgical cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist (a checklist of 13 things) required to increase accuracy, transparency, and usefulness of case reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keywords (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient Information (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist; includes essential patient details needed in a case report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Findings (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeline (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist; a chronological representation of the patient’s course and key events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diagnostic Assessment (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Therapeutic Intervention (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow-up and Outcomes / Questions (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist; describe follow-up care, outcomes, and any outstanding questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discussion (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist; place the case in context of existing knowledge and implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient Perspective (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist; include the patient's viewpoint when available to increase transparency and usefulness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informed Consent (CARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist; confirm that informed consent for publication was obtained.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the SCARE (Surgical CAse REport) checklist, which tailors CARE to surgical case reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keywords (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the SCARE checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the SCARE checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the SCARE checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient Information (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Patient Information -- including demographic details, presentation, past medical and surgical history, other relevant history
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SCARE requires more detailed patient information for surgical reports: demographic details; how the patient presented; past medical and surgical history; and other relevant history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Findings (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the SCARE checklist; document physical exam and key clinical signs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeline (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the SCARE checklist; include a clear chronology of events related to the case.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diagnostic Assessment (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Diagnostic Assessment -- including diagnostic methods, diagnostic challenges, diagnostic reasoning, prognostic characteristics
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SCARE emphasizes describing used diagnostic methods, any diagnostic challenges encountered, the clinical reasoning behind diagnoses, and relevant prognostic features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Therapeutic Intervention (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Therapeutic Intervention -- including pre-intervention considerations, intervention, intervention details, who performed the procedure, changes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For surgical cases, SCARE expects detailed reporting of pre-intervention considerations, the intervention itself, procedural details, operators/performers, and any intra-procedural changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow-up and Questions (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow-up and Questions -- including intervention adherence and compliance, complications and adverse events
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe follow-up, patient adherence/compliance with interventions, and report any complications or adverse events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discussion (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Discussion -- including strengths, weaknesses and limitations in approach, relevant literature review, 'take-away' lessons
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SCARE asks authors to discuss strengths and limitations of the approach, relate the case to relevant literature, and provide clear take-away lessons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient Perspective (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the patient's perspective when possible, as in CARE.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informed Consent (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm that informed consent for publication was obtained; explicit requirement in SCARE as in CARE.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Information (SCARE)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SCARE checklist includes an item for any additional information relevant to the surgical case report (e.g., ethical approval, funding, conflicts).
